newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Two dead in petrol bomb attack on Belgian cafe.
newsitem.headline: Two dead in petrol bomb attack on Belgian cafe.

text.p: Two people died on Monday and six others were seriously injured in an attack with a petrol bomb on a Brussels cafe, Belgian BRTN radio said.
It said the building collapsed after a fire caused by the attack. Four suspects have been arrested, it said. The motives for the attack were unclear, it added.
Police declined to give details, but BRTN radio said the device went off at around 0300 GMT in the six-storey building in the Brussels commune of Molenbeek.
Belga news agency said two people were reported missing.
It said the two dead victims were two men, aged 46 and 37.
Firemen suspected arson, Belga said, adding that neighbours had heard the sound of breaking glass shortly before the blaze.
